heading.title: Of Grant of Probate and Letters of Administration

article.title: Accrual of representation to surviving executor.
article.content:
226Accrual of representation to surviving executor.

Section 226  ·  Part IX · Chapter I  ·  page 70 of the Act
When probate has been granted to several executors, and one of them dies, the entire representation of the testator accrues to the surviving executor or executors.
